content.value_statement: Computer vision teams need reliable guidance for models, datasets, inference, and deployment. This skill helps plan and optimize production vision pipelines with practical engineering checks.
actual_capabilities: Plans object detection workflows for datasets, labels, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Explains segmentation approaches for semantic masks, instance masks, and model selection.
Reviews inference pipelines for batching, quantization, model export, and latency targets.
Guides video analysis designs with frame processing, tracking, monitoring, and scaling.
Documents production practices for observability, drift checks, rollout strategy, and incident response.
limitations: It provides guidance and starter scripts, not trained model weights or hosted infrastructure.
The included scripts are skeleton utilities and need project-specific implementation before use.
GPU requirements, dataset quality, and licensing must be evaluated by the user.
Specialized 3D vision, LiDAR, and robotics stacks may need deeper domain review.

use_cases.title: Train a detection model
use_cases.description: Create a practical plan for dataset preparation, augmentation, training, validation, and model export.

use_cases.title: Review a production architecture
use_cases.description: Evaluate latency, throughput, monitoring, drift detection, and rollout risks before deployment.

use_cases.title: Scope a vision feature
use_cases.description: Translate product goals into model choices, data needs, performance targets, and delivery milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Vision Project
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new use case
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a computer vision project for [use case]. Include data needs, model options, evaluation metrics, and deployment risks.

prompt_templates.title: Design Detection Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an object detection training workflow for [object types] using [dataset size]. Include labeling, augmentation, metrics, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Inference
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this inference pipeline: [pipeline details]. Recommend changes for batching, export format, quantization, hardware, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this production vision system for launch: [architecture]. Check reliability, observability, privacy, cost, rollback, and drift management.

output_examples.input: I need to detect damaged parts on a factory line.
output: Define defect classes with operations and quality teams.
Collect balanced examples across lighting, camera angles, and product variants.
Start with a pretrained detector and measure precision, recall, and missed defects.
Set latency targets using the actual line speed and camera frame rate.
Add monitoring for image quality, model confidence, and defect distribution changes.

output_examples.input: Our video model is too slow for real-time analysis.
output: Profile preprocessing, model inference, post-processing, and data transfer separately.
Test smaller model variants before changing hardware.
Evaluate batching only if it does not violate frame latency requirements.
Try model export and quantization with accuracy checks on representative video.
Track latency percentiles, not only average latency.

output_examples.input: Can this segmentation system launch next month?
output: Review annotation quality and class definitions first.
Validate masks on edge cases from real production data.
Confirm privacy handling for stored images and videos.
Prepare rollback steps and human review paths for low confidence results.
Launch with drift monitoring and scheduled error analysis.

best_practices: Validate label quality and dataset coverage before tuning model architecture.
Measure accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability on production-like data.
Version datasets, training settings, model artifacts, and evaluation reports together.
anti_patterns: Choosing a larger model before profiling the full pipeline.
Training on clean examples only and ignoring real camera conditions.
Launching without monitoring for data drift, image quality, and confidence changes.

faq.question: What computer vision tasks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers object detection, segmentation, video analysis, model training, inference optimization, and deployment planning.

faq.question: Does it include working model weights?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and skeleton scripts, but users must bring or train model weights.

faq.question: Can it help with real-time systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for latency targets, batching, quantization, hardware choice, and monitoring.

faq.question: Which tools are mentioned by the skill?
faq.answer: The skill references Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, YOLO, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, and cloud platforms.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated image data?
faq.answer: It can guide privacy and compliance planning, but legal and security teams must approve regulated workflows.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
